pillars.title: Generering af Series Room
pillars.header: Skab et univers, ikke et klip
pillars.body: Beskriv din serie eller YouTube-kanal én gang, så opbygger SceneFlow hele universet – herunder handling, medvirkende og en ubegrænset række af episoder – ved hjælp af et fælles Reference Library, der sikrer, at alle episoder holder sig til brandet.

steps.title: Start med dit koncept
steps.description: Indtast et koncept eller en detaljeret beskrivelse af din serie eller YouTube-kanal. SceneFlow omdanner det til et struktureret, produktionsklart fundament – uden behov for prompt engineering.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Modtagelse af nye serier – koncept- eller kanalbeskrivelse

steps.title: Gennemgå SceneFlow-baseline
steps.description: SceneFlow leverer et professionelt udgangspunkt, der er vurderet via Audience Resonance-analysen. Læs eller lyt til det fortalte overblik, og sæt derefter dit eget præg på retningen.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Baseline for serien – Audience Resonance-score og kommenteret oversigt

steps.title: Opret ubegrænsede episoder
steps.description: Skab lige så mange episoder, som din historie kræver. Hver episode arver seriens DNA, så persongalleri, tone og univers forbliver konsistente fra første episode til sæsonafslutningen.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Episodeoversigt – ubegrænsede episoder genereret ud fra seriens overordnede forløb

steps.title: Gennemgå Reference Library
steps.description: Gennemse det fælles Reference Library – karakterer, stemmer, kostumer, lokationer og rekvisitter – der er oprettet og vedligeholdt via Production Stage og genbruges i alle episoder.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Delt Reference Library – karakterer, stemmer, lokationer, rekvisitter

steps.title: Styr den intelligente skriveassistent
steps.description: Tilpas serien eller et hvilket som helst afsnit ved at tale eller skrive dine instruktioner. Den intelligente skriveassistent omskriver professionelle tekster med det samme – uden en tom side og uden behov for avanceret prompt-optimering.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent skriveassistent – vejledning om stemme eller tekst til serier og episoder

steps.title: Start produktionen med ét klik
steps.description: Når et afsnit føles rigtigt, kan du starte produktionen med et enkelt klik og gå direkte videre til den guidede Production Stage-pipeline.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Start produktionen af et valgt afsnit med ét klik

pillars.title: SFAIBLUEPRINT_RUMBETEGNELSE
pillars.body: Blueprint Room er dit dybdegående filmoplæg – synopsis, narrative nøglepunkter, karakterer, tone og stil – der på forhånd er vurderet via Audience Resonance-analysen, så du godkender en historie, der rammer plet, allerede før det første billede renderes.

steps.title: Gennemgå baseline-Blueprint
steps.description: Åbn en professionel SFAI-baseline med indbygget analyse af målgrupperesonans. Læs eller lyt til den fortalte oversigt for at høre præcis, hvorfor den fungerer.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Baseline-Blueprint – behandling med Audience Resonance-score

steps.title: Styr den intelligente skriveassistent
steps.description: Finjuster synopsis, handlingspunkter, karakterer og meget mere ved at tale eller skrive dine instruktioner. Den intelligente skriveassistent reviderer behandlingen med det samme – uden behov for avanceret prompt-teknik.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent skriveassistent – redigering af synopsis, narrative nøglepunkter og karakterer

steps.title: Gennemgå begrundelsen
steps.description: Åbn afsnittet "Begrundelse" for at få en kreativ forklaring på den aktuelle Blueprint – altså den narrative logik bag hvert enkelt dramatisk skift og karaktervalg.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Begrundelsespanel – kreativ forklaring af Blueprint

steps.title: Start produktionen, når alt er klar
steps.description: Når historien sidder lige i skabet, kan produktionen gå i gang – og hele pipelinen viderefører jeres godkendte kreative DNA uden afvigelser.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Åbn Production Stage – parathedskontrol baseret på en godkendt blueprint

pillars.title: Production Stage
pillars.body: Production Stage håndterer samtidig generering via flere motorer – manuskript, lyd, billeder og video – i samarbejde med Intelligent Assistant Director og Screening Room samt flersprogede streams, der fører dig fra godkendt manuskript til en færdig 4K-master.

steps.title: Gennemgå grundlaget for scriptet
steps.description: Tag udgangspunkt i et professionelt grundmanuskript med Audience Resonance-analyse. Læs eller lyt til den indtalte analyse, så du ved, hvad der rammer plet, før du bruger en kredit.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Basis-script – analyse af Audience Resonance og fortalt oversigt

steps.title: Optimer scene for scene
steps.description: Brug den intelligente skriveassistent til at optimere manuskriptet scene for scene – stram dialogen op, juster de dramatiske skift, og foretag forbedringer med et enkelt klik via tale eller tekst.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent skriveassistent – optimering af manuskriptet scene for scene

steps.title: Opbyg Reference Library
steps.description: Opret eller opdater referencelageret med karakterer, stemmer, beklædning, lokationer og rekvisitter – uanset om de er scriptede, skræddersyede eller uploadede. Rediger referencebilleder direkte – uden tilfældige "spillemaskine"-genereringer.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reference Library — karakterer, stemmer, kostumer, lokationer, rekvisitter

steps.title: Generer lyd
steps.description: Generér dialog, fortællerstemme, lydeffekter og musik ved hjælp af Run All Agents på tværs af alle scener, Audio Agent pr. scene eller trin for trin – voiceover i modersmålskvalitet på mere end 70 sprog.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Audio Agent — alle scener, enkeltscene eller beat for beat

steps.title: Generer og rediger billedrammer
steps.description: Generer beat-frames med Run All Agents og Stills Agent for hver scene eller beat for beat, og rediger derefter en hvilken som helst frame med Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD) – du skal blot beskrive ændringen.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Beat-frames med Intelligent Assistant Director-klip

steps.title: Gennemgå animaticen
steps.description: Afspil hele animaticen – billeder, dialog, lydeffekter og musik – i det interaktive Screening Room, og del et link til feedback uden at eksportere en fil.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Screening Room – interaktiv gennemgang og deling af animatics

steps.title: Generer video
steps.description: Skab bevægelse ud fra godkendte billeder med Video Agent – enten scene for scene eller trin for trin. Lav nye optagelser med Intelligent Assistant Director – uden endeløse, tilfældige genereringer, der minder om en spillemaskine.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Generering af Video Agent med IAD-gentagelser

steps.title: Rediger i mixeren
steps.description: Finpuds hver scene i Mixeren – undertekster, klipning, dubbing, overlays og lydbalance – og færdiggør indholdet på en brandsikker måde uden at forlade studiet.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Mixer – undertekster, trimning, eftersynkronisering og lydstyring

steps.title: Render og gennemgå scener
steps.description: Render dine scener, og gennemgå og del dem derefter via Screening Room for at sikre godkendelse før den endelige samling.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Renderede scener gennemgået og delt i Screening Room

steps.title: Generer flersprogede streams
steps.description: Skab dubbede eller læbesynkroniserede sprogversioner ud fra den samme godkendte klipning – og nå ud til mere end 70 markeder uden at skulle optage så meget som ét enkelt billede om.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Flersprogede streams – dubbet og læbesynkroniseret til det enkelte område

steps.title: Generér endelig version og udgiv
steps.description: Render den endelige produktion til en master og udgiv den – med automatisk genererede miniaturebilleder, titler og beskrivelser, der er klar til din YouTube-kanal og andre platforme.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Endelig rendering og publicering til YouTube med ét klik

rooms.label: SFAISERIES_RUMBETEGNELSE
rooms.headline: Byg et univers én gang. Producer episoder for evigt.
rooms.promise: Udvikl en sæson med flere episoder med én fælles kreativ bibel. Dine rollebesætninger, lokationer, historietråde og visuelle DNA overføres automatisk til hver episode, du spinner op. Producerer du en selvstændig film? Spring direkte til Blueprint Room.

features.title: New Series
features.description: Pitch your series, anthology, or episodic channel concept in plain language. Interactive AI refinement sharpens your premise, target audience, and visual tone before generating a complete multi-episode season baseline—complete with overarching plot arcs, recurring character hooks, and episode-by-episode breakdowns.
features.screenshot: Create New Series — intent, Clarify and Confirm, Generate Series

items.title: Plain-language series pitch
items.description: Pitch the premise, episode format, target demographic, and visual art style in plain language.

items.title: Interactive Clarify & Confirm
items.description: Clarify and Confirm sharpens the season synopsis, tone, and thematic pillars with you before anything is generated.

items.title: Multi-episode season baseline
items.description: Generate Series builds a structured five-episode season arc with individual synopses and story hooks that you can expand anytime.

items.title: World & genre calibration
items.description: Lock visual aesthetics, era settings, and recurring narrative motifs up front so every episode shares the same creative DNA.

features.title: Season Bible & Continuity
features.description: Read or listen to the narrated season overview and episode slate. SceneFlow locks your story threads, cast profiles, recurring locations, and signature props into a shared Reference Library that every episode inherits automatically—eliminating continuity drift across multi-part storytelling.
features.screenshot: Overview Listen, Episodes Listen, Consistency, Continuity — Cast, Locations, Props, Settings

items.title: Narrated season & episode audit
items.description: Audit the overarching season overview and every individual episode synopsis with built-in studio audio narration.

items.title: Cross-episode story consistency
items.description: Visual aesthetics, canonical plot events, and character relationship threads stay locked across the entire season.

items.title: Shared Reference Library inheritance
items.description: Cast portraits, voice profiles, wardrobes, locations, and signature props carry automatically into every episode you produce.

items.title: Centralized canon management
items.description: Update a character look, location plate, or prop once in the Series Bible to propagate the change to future episodes.

features.title: Audience Resonance
features.description: Test your season arc against your target demographic before writing a single script. Review episode-by-episode resonance scores, binge-retention curves, and structural critiques, then apply data-backed story improvements with one click—only when you agree with the note.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance analysis, then Actionable Insights, unapplied

items.title: Demographic & retention scoring
items.description: Multi-axis scores and structural analysis reveal how your season arc and episode cliffhangers land with your target audience.

items.title: Episode-by-episode diagnostics
items.description: Spot mid-season pacing dips, character underutilization, or tonal drift across the full episode slate before scripting.

items.title: Director's prerogative
items.description: Actionable Insights update your series bible and episode outlines only when you explicitly choose to apply them.

features.title: The Series Director
features.description: Reshape the entire season by voice or text. Shift the dramatic tone, raise the stakes, introduce a new antagonist, or rework a character arc across all episodes at once while keeping the rest of your storyline and continuity bible intact.
features.screenshot: Series Director — direction, focus, accept

items.title: Plain-language season direction
items.description: Speak or type your creative note and target overarching plot, characters, episode arcs, tone, or world setting.

items.title: Surgical multi-episode updates
items.description: Nothing changes until you accept the previewed revision, and unrelated story threads stay completely untouched.

items.title: Guided AI recommendations
items.description: Apply one-click story improvements surfaced by Audience Resonance or steer every creative choice yourself.

features.title: Episode-Level Direction
features.description: Zoom into any individual episode to rework its plot outline, act structure, pacing, or cold-open hook in isolation—without destabilizing neighboring episodes or mutating the rest of your season slate.
features.screenshot: Episodes — Direct this episode, other episodes unchanged

items.title: Isolated episode rewrites
items.description: Direct changes to a single episode's synopsis, act beats, and character focus without altering neighboring episodes.

items.title: Locked season integrity
items.description: The overarching season bible, shared cast continuity, and remaining episode slate stay locked while you iterate.

items.title: Pre-launch beat polishing
items.description: Refine individual episode hooks and cliffhangers until the episode is ready to launch into the Blueprint Room.

features.title: One-Click Episode Launch
features.description: When an episode's outline hits the mark, launch it straight into the Blueprint Room with a single click—bringing its synopsis, narrative beats, recurring cast, voice profiles, locations, and visual style automatically wired in.
features.screenshot: Start Project — outline and cast already on the episode

items.title: Instant Blueprint handoff
items.description: Launch any approved episode directly into the Blueprint Room with a single click to begin detailed beat and script work.

items.title: Pre-wired creative DNA
items.description: The episode outline, synopsis, story beats, cast profiles, wardrobes, and locations travel automatically with zero re-entry.

items.title: Parallel episode production
items.description: Spin up multiple episodes from the same season slate as independent projects that share the same canonical series assets.

rooms.label: SFAIBLUEPRINT_RUMBETEGNELSE
rooms.headline: Lås historien og udseendet, før et enkelt billede gengives.
rooms.promise: Uanset om du lancerer en episode fra Series Room eller starter en selvstændig funktion, er Blueprint Room, hvor dit kreative DNA låser sig ind. Perfektgør beat-arket, rollebesætningen, lokationerne og den visuelle stil her – så Production Stage bygger det rigtige script på det første gennemløb.

features.title: Start the Blueprint
features.description: Bring in an episode from your series slate with its outline, cast, and world pre-loaded, or pitch a brand-new standalone film concept from scratch and let AI validate, enhance, and structure the foundational treatment.
features.screenshot: Series episode already known, or Start Your Project — intent, Validate & Enhance with AI, Generate Blueprint

items.title: Seamless from Series Room
items.description: Series episodes arrive with their outline, synopsis, story beats, recurring cast, and locations already attached.

items.title: Standalone film or short
items.description: Pitch a new film concept in plain language, refine it with AI validation, and generate a complete film treatment.

items.title: Narrated treatment overview
items.description: Read or listen to the narrated logline, synopsis, and creative reasoning to verify the story foundation immediately.

features.title: The Beat Sheet
features.description: Structure the dramatic spine of your film before dialogue is written. Read or listen to your narrative beat sheet, reorder acts, and fine-tune scene pacing here—every beat you lock in the Blueprint Room drives a dedicated chapter in the Production Stage.
features.screenshot: Beats tab, with Listen

items.title: Narrative spine
items.description: Beats are authored and locked in the Blueprint Room before script generation begins.

items.title: Pacing & structural discipline
items.description: Optimizing the beat sheet here ensures the multi-scene screenplay builds with tight dramatic structure and clear turning points.

items.title: Beat-to-chapter mapping
items.description: Production Stage turns each beat into a chapter.

items.title: Narrated beat audition
items.description: Listen to the beat sheet read aloud to feel the rhythm and momentum of the story before compiling the script.

features.title: Cast & World Design
features.description: Define your characters, vocal identities, period wardrobes, and primary locations before the screenplay is generated—ensuring the script is written around your exact cast, blocking environments, and visual atmosphere from page one.
features.screenshot: Characters tab, then Setting on Story

items.title: Rich character profiles
items.description: Direct your cast profiles, backstories, and physical attributes up front so dialogue and blocking match each character.

items.title: World, era & locations
items.description: Establish primary settings, lighting palettes, and cinematic style on the Story tab to anchor every scene's environment.

items.title: Zero script refactoring
items.description: Locking cast and locations before script generation eliminates costly rewrites and continuity mismatches on the Production Stage.

features.title: The Blueprint Director
features.description: Speak or type your story notes to revise beats, character motivations, or world details without prompt engineering. Preview a balanced revision side-by-side with creative reasoning—nothing changes in your treatment until you approve the cut.
features.screenshot: Blueprint Director — direction, focus, preview, Apply revision

items.title: Targeted voice or text notes
items.description: Speak or type your direction and focus the revision surgically on Beats, Characters, or Story.

items.title: Side-by-side revision preview
items.description: Review a balanced revision and its underlying story reasoning before committing any changes to your Blueprint.

items.title: You hold the creative lock
items.description: Nothing in your treatment, beat sheet, or character roster changes until you explicitly apply the revision.

features.title: Audience Resonance
features.description: Score your treatment against your target audience's cultural, genre, and demographic profile before generating the script. Catch structural pacing gaps or weak character stakes early and apply targeted recommendations in the Blueprint Director.

items.title: Pre-script audience validation
items.description: Analyze your treatment against your saved target audience to inspect category scores, strengths, and story risks.

items.title: Actionable story remedies
items.description: Each insight pairs a structural diagnosis with a concrete rewrite recommendation tailored to your beat sheet and cast.

items.title: Selective one-click application
items.description: Recommendations only modify your Blueprint when you choose to apply them in the Blueprint Director.

features.title: Greenlight to Production

items.title: Seamless script compilation
items.description: Stepping onto the Production Stage compiles the full multi-scene screenplay directly from your approved Blueprint.

items.title: Locked continuity foundation
items.description: Your storyline, beat-to-chapter structure, cast profiles, and locations arrive ready for scene and shot direction.

items.title: Shareable Blueprint review
items.description: Share the locked Blueprint with co-creators or executive stakeholders for sign-off before commencing production.

rooms.label: Production Stage
rooms.headline: Fra manuskript til master, alt i ét rum.
rooms.promise: Blueprint er låst. Din rollebesætning er castet. Gå nu ind på Production Stage. Hvert kapitel, scene og skud er organiseret i en lineær arbejdsgang. Du styrer hensigten; intelligente agenter udfører generationen.

groups.label: Direkte & kontrol
groups.headline: Tal filmens sprog, ikke syntaksen af prompter.
groups.description: Spild ikke tid på at skrive søgeord i parentes. Production Stage forstår naturlig retning og anvender dit syn på tværs af hele scenen eller ned til det specifikke skud.

features.title: Scene Production Workflow (Fullscreen)
features.description: Open the dedicated Fullscreen Scene Production Studio to direct every stage of a scene from one unified 8-tab command bar (`Direction · Audio · Music · Continuity · Stills · Clips · Mixer · Streams`). Reorder shots in the left-hand Shot Rail with live readiness badges, inspect the 16:9 Still & Clip Stage alongside structured camera, blocking, emotion, and lighting cards, and track end-to-end scene completion without losing context.
features.screenshot: Scene Production Workflow (Fullscreen) — 8-tab linear studio, sortable Shot Rail, and structured Shot Direction Workbench

items.title: 8-tab fullscreen linear studio
items.description: Move seamlessly across Direction, Audio, Music, Continuity, Stills, Clips, Mixer, and Streams inside a distraction-free fullscreen workspace.

items.title: Sortable Shot Rail & live badges
items.description: Drag to reorder shots in the left-hand rail while tracking real-time badges for Action, Dialogue, Narration, SFX, Music, Signage, Final 4K stills, and clips In the Can.

items.title: Structured Shot Direction Workbench
items.description: Inspect the 16:9 Still & Clip Stage beside structured cards for spoken beats, camera lens and motion, talent blocking and gaze, lighting, locked continuity refs, and compiled prompts.

items.title: End-to-end scene pipeline telemetry
items.description: Monitor readiness across direction, voice and score, keyframes, multi-take clips, broadcast mixing, and localized streams before publishing.

features.title: The Scene & Shot Director
features.description: Type or speak your direction in plain language. Tell the agent who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is. The Shot Director automatically writes the complex underlying prompts for your stills and clips while syncing camera lens, focal length, talent blocking, and lighting across the scene.
features.screenshot: The Scene & Shot Director — plain-language direction for stills and clips

items.title: Plain-language film direction
items.description: Type or speak who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is without writing bracketed prompt syntax.

items.title: Scene-wide or per-shot precision
items.description: Apply atmospheric direction across the entire scene or drill down into an individual shot's framing, lens, blocking, and lighting.

items.title: Automatic prompt compilation
items.description: The Shot Director automatically writes and syncs the underlying keyframe and motion prompts for your stills and clips.

items.title: Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD)
items.description: Request surgical revisions to camera angles, character posture, or scene tension in plain language while keeping unrelated beats untouched.

features.title: The Continuity Library
features.description: Absolute visual and vocal consistency across your entire film or series. Automatically generate or manually assign locked reference portraits, multi-angle turnaround sheets, scene-specific wardrobes, locations, and essential props—ensuring every shot matches the Blueprint without character drift.
features.screenshot: The Continuity Library — cast, wardrobes, locations, and essential props

items.title: Cast identity & turnaround locks
items.description: Anchor every character with diptych portraits, turnaround sheets, and locked voice profiles across every shot and episode.

items.title: Scene-specific wardrobes & props
items.description: Assign period or scene-specific wardrobes and essential hero props per shot so costumes and hand-held items stay unified.

items.title: Generate, upload, or surgically edit
items.description: Automatically generate reference images, upload custom studio plates, or refine details with the Intelligent Assistant Director.

items.title: Continuity readiness gate
items.description: Verify that all cast, wardrobe, location, and prop anchors are locked in the Continuity tab before generating scene keyframes.

features.title: Audience Resonance Integration
features.description: Get a read on the room before you render. AI analyzes your script against your target audience, providing scene-by-scene insights, pacing diagnostics, and dialogue tension scores. Apply recommended directions instantly, or trust your gut and ignore them.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance Integration — scene-by-scene audience insights

items.title: Scene-by-scene audience insights
items.description: AI analyzes your script against your target audience before you render to surface pacing, tension, and engagement scores.

items.title: Narrated critique & recommendations
items.description: Listen to the narrated analysis and inspect targeted scene-level rewrite recommendations backed by demographic reasoning.

items.title: Your creative call
items.description: Apply recommended directions instantly with one click, or trust your gut and ignore them.

features.title: Production Planner
features.description: Establish the budget and schedule generation across every scene and chapter using SceneFlow credits or your own BYOK API keys. Set still and clip targets per shot, toggle between Draft and Final resolution tiers, and forecast compute spend before you render.
features.screenshot: Production Planner — budget, schedule, and BYOK API keys

items.title: Budget and schedule forecasting
items.description: Establish the budget and schedule generation across every scene and chapter with transparent per-shot credit estimates before you render.

items.title: SceneFlow credits or BYOK keys

features.description: Built for traditional and AI filmmakers alike. Preview a clean, formatted screenplay in-studio and export in industry-standard formats (PDF, FDX, Fountain). Use SceneFlow as a standalone script room—or pair your screenplay with a Pre-Vis Animatic and Promo Trailer to pitch financiers and secure project funding.

items.description: Preview the formatted script in the studio and export in industry-standard PDF, Final Draft FDX, or Fountain format.

items.title: For traditional filmmakers
items.description: Use SceneFlow as an intelligent script production platform without generating video.

items.title: Pitch & project funding
items.description: Package your script with a Pre-Vis Animatic and Promo Trailers to pitch and acquire project funding.

groups.headline: Bevis snittet, før du bruger beregningen.
groups.description: Gæt ikke, hvordan en scene vil spille. SceneFlow adskiller generering af lyd og stillbilleder fra dyr bevægelsesgengivelse, så du først kan kontrollere rytmen i redigeringen.

features.title: The Audio Agent
features.description: Generate expressive character dialogue, narrator voiceover, action sound effects, and musical scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene. Cast voices automatically match character profiles from your Continuity Library or can be custom-tuned per beat.
features.screenshot: The Audio Agent — concurrent dialogue, sound effects, and music scores

items.title: Concurrent multi-track audio
items.description: Generate dialogue, narration, sound effects, and music scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene.

items.title: Locked character voice casting
items.description: Cast voices automatically match character profiles from your Reference Library or can be custom-tuned for timbre and cadence.

items.title: Batch scene or single-shot runs
items.description: Run the Audio Agent across the entire scene in one pass or regenerate individual dialogue and SFX beats on demand.

features.title: Dialogue, SFX & Musical Score Workbench
features.description: Open the Fullscreen `Audio` and `Music` tabs to direct every sonic layer of your scene. Shape vocal performances with emotional delivery tags (`[obsessive, muttered]`) and Hi-Fi Studio quality, extract embedded audio directly from video clips, dial in SFX duration presets (`Auto`, `Short 3s`, `Medium 8s`, `Long 15s`), and compose multi-shot Lyria musical score cues with custom intro fades.
features.screenshot: Dialogue, SFX & Musical Score Workbench — Fullscreen Audio & Music tabs with score cues, voice casting, and SFX duration presets

items.title: Multi-shot musical score cues
items.description: Compose custom Lyria musical score cues that span specific shot ranges with configurable intro fades and auto-ducking metadata.

items.title: Performance Director & delivery tags
items.description: Direct spoken dialogue with bracketed emotional delivery tags, Hi-Fi Studio synthesis, and per-shot voice casting.

items.title: Precision SFX duration presets
items.description: Time action sound effects to your shot choreography using Auto, Short 3s, Medium 8s, or Long 15s duration presets.

items.title: Extract audio from video clips
items.description: Pull embedded audio directly from generated motion clips to preserve native on-camera speech or ambient foley.

features.title: The Stills Agent
features.description: Rapidly batch-generate the high-resolution keyframe images that illustrate your shot direction across the scene. Regenerate, edit, or upload your own references to lock the composition, lighting, and character blocking before committing to video.
features.screenshot: The Stills Agent — keyframe composition and references

items.title: Batch keyframe generation
items.description: Rapidly generate the keyframe images that illustrate your shot direction across every shot in the scene.

items.title: Automatic continuity anchoring
items.description: Every generated frame incorporates your locked cast portraits, scene wardrobes, locations, and hero props automatically.

items.title: Lock composition before motion
items.description: Regenerate, edit, or upload your own references before committing compute to full motion video rendering.

paths.label: Skaber
paths.outcome: Lever til tiden – stop med at genopbygge i hvert enkelt værktøj
paths.narrative: Du har historien på plads, men hvert afsnit kræver geneksport af assets, nye prompts i nye faner og et håb om, at kontinuiteten holder. SceneFlow forbinder Series Room, Blueprint Room og Production Stage i ét samlet studie – så du kan godkende det visuelle udtryk i pre-vis, generere indholdet scene for scene og levere sammenhængende afsnit til tiden i stedet for at skulle starte forfra hver gang.

example.challengeDescription: Du har et stærkt manuskript, men processen med at lære seks forskellige værktøjer til generering og redigering – eller at hænge fast i endeløse, repetitive videoloops – forsinker hver eneste upload. Succesfulde YouTube-serier og den dramatiske rytme i YouTube-tv kræver en hurtigere produktionstakt, end hvad fragmenterede AI-faner kan præstere.
example.solutionDescription: Lever alt fra episodiske serier til "scroll-stoppende" korte videoer fra ét og samme studie – med alt fra beat-baseret pre-vis og visuel kontinuitet til publiceringsklare masters skræddersyet til den YouTube-drevne creator-økonomi.

paths.label: Internt team

paths.narrative: Interne videoanmodninger hober sig op, mens bureauers tilbud forlænger tidsplanerne, og brand-retningslinjerne skrider i hver enkelt korrekturrunde. SceneFlow samler L&D, kommunikation og produktforklaringer i ét styret workflow – så dit team selv har kontrol over manuskript, pre-vis og det endelige resultat uden at skulle leje studie eller vente på eksterne leverandører.

extendedScenes.title: Ud over klippet på 8 sekunder
extendedScenes.subtitle: Bryd ud af begrænsningen med enkelte klip – godkend først det visuelle udtryk, og udvid derefter scenen trin for trin til sammenhængende monologer, forklarende indslag og dialogsekvenser.
extendedScenes.intro: SceneFlow lover ikke én ubegrænset rendering. Systemet planlægger lange sekvenser som en række led: et indledende klip på op til 8 sekunder efterfulgt af løbende udvidelser på 7 sekunder – hvor du godkender sekvensen, før du bruger dine credits.

steps.title: 8s indledende klip
steps.description: Frame-til-video eller billede-til-video fra godkendt Shot Frames fastlåser kompositionen før bevægelse.

steps.title: +7s-udvidelsestrin
steps.description: Hvert skridt viderefører samme vinkel og bevægelse – ideelt til uafbrudt dialog inden for en sekvens.

steps.title: Godkendelse baseret på overgåelse af forventninger
steps.description: Lange linjer opdeles automatisk under gennemgangen af forvisualiseringen. Du godkender billederne, før kæden renderes – der er ikke tale om tilfældig generering som på en spillemaskine.

steps.title: Production Mixer afslutning
steps.description: Segmenter kædes sammen til en samlet sceneafspilning, og elastisk lyd håndterer speak, der varer længere end videoen.

extendedScenes.footnote: Udvidelseskæder kræver den primære Google-genereringssti og gyldige videoreferencer mellem trinene (referencerne udløber efter ca. 48 timer). Hvert API-trin holder sig inden for Veos varighedsgrænser – den samlede varighed opnås ved at kæde trinene sammen, ikke ved en enkelt, lang rendering.

creativeRange.title: Enhver stil, enhver skærm
creativeRange.titleAccent: Dit kreative DNA, fastlåst i Blueprint
creativeRange.subtitle: Blueprint Room er stedet, hvor dit kreative DNA fastlægges – herunder kunststil, billedformat, tone og den centrale fortælling. SceneFlow integrerer disse valg i henholdsvis treatment, Audience Resonance og manuskriptgenerering, så sceneanvisningerne stemmer overens med dit billedudsnit og visuelle udtryk helt fra begyndelsen – og ikke blot er noget, der tilføjes som eksportindstillinger i sidste øjeblik.

pillars.title: Form følger funktion (og indramning)
pillars.description: Skærmstørrelsen dikterer den visuelle historiefortælling. Et vertikalt 9:16-format kræver strammere iscenesættelse, hurtigere "hooks" og en instruktion med fokus på nærbilleder – det er helt anderledes end iscenesættelse til 16:9-widescreen. Lås billedformatet i Blueprint, så manuskriptgenereringen skaber sceneanvisninger, der passer til billedrammen.

pillars.title: Kunststilen dikterer prosaen
pillars.description: Noir-anime og Pixar-3D kræver forskellig dialog, atmosfære og rytme. Vælg dit visuelle udtryk i Blueprint, og LLM'en indlejrer denne tekstur i manuskriptets DNA – ikke blot som et filter, der lægges på efterfølgende.

creativeRange.blueprintTagline: Tone og kernefortælling fuldender låsen – Blueprint er hjernen; produktionen er musklerne.

artStyles.subsectionIntro: Dit visuelle udtryk er ikke blot en render-indstilling – det er manuskriptets stemme. Fastlås den visuelle stil i Blueprint, så arver hvert enkelt element den æstetik.
artStyles.footnote: Fastlagt det visuelle fundament for Blueprint – videreført gennem manuskript, pre-vis og endelig rendering.

steps.stepLabel: Start med dit koncept eller eksisterende manuskript.
steps.shortDescription: Start med et koncept beskrevet i naturligt sprog, eller importér dit filmmanuskript – Fountain, Final Draft – eller indsæt dit manuskript.
steps.detailedDescription: SceneFlow accepterer idéer i almindeligt sprog eller strukturerede manuskriptformater. AI'en hjælper med at udvide koncepter til treatments og kan importere eksisterende manuskripter, så du aldrig skal starte fra en blank side.
steps.screenshotSlot: Indsæt skærmbillede: Dialogboks til indtastning af nyt projektkoncept eller import af script

steps.stepLabel: Optimer dit koncept med Blueprint Room
steps.shortDescription: Omdan idéer til et struktureret treatment – logline, narrative hovedpunkter, karakterer og tone – før den tunge rendering.
steps.detailedDescription: Blueprint udarbejder automatisk et omfattende handlingsreferat. Finjuster karakterudvikling, centrale plotpunkter og den fortællende tone ved hjælp af intelligente forslag. Delingslinks gør det muligt for interessenter at gennemgå materialet før Production Stage.

steps.stepLabel: Optimer dit script med Audience Resonance
steps.shortDescription: Få en vurdering af, hvor godt dit manuskript passer til målgruppen, og implementér anbefalinger scene for scene med løsninger, der kan aktiveres med et enkelt klik.
steps.detailedDescription: Audience Resonance (AR) foretager en kritisk analyse af dit manuskript i forhold til den målgruppe, du definerer. Få vurderinger på afsnitsniveau, konkrete anbefalinger og Guided Edits – anvend rettelser automatisk for hver scene, eller foretag globale ændringer i manuskriptet direkte fra AR-dialogboksen.

steps.shortDescription: Generér dialoglyd og nøglebilleder (shot frames) scene for scene. Del animatics til godkendelse, før der afsættes midler til den endelige videoproduktion.
steps.detailedDescription: Pre-Vis Studio genererer instruktion, lyd og nøglebilleder (shot frames) for hver scene – kontrolpunkter, der minimerer bekosteligt omarbejde, hvis karakterer eller tone ændres. Del afspilleren for at samarbejde; den færdige animatic kan i mange projekter udgøre det endelige leveringsprodukt.

steps.shortDescription: Generér hvert klip i Clips, mix lyden i Mixer, og eksportér sprogversioner i Streams.
steps.detailedDescription: Clips genererer videoen til hvert enkelt klip (shot) ud fra godkendte stillbilleder. Mixeren fastlægger timing, vandmærker og lyd. Streams er scenens sprogversioner.
subPoints: Klip – optaget video baseret på godkendte stillbilleder
Mixer – vandmærke, tekstoverlejring og lydtiming pr. scene
Streams – sprogversioner af scenen, klar til Screening Room

steps.stepLabel: Test din produktion med Screening Room
steps.shortDescription: Se en forhåndsvisning af scener i rækkefølge, saml en master-MP4, og afhold visninger, der kan deles, med struktureret feedback.
steps.detailedDescription: Screening Room afspejler brugeroplevelsen fra Pre-Vis-afspilleren, men afspiller renderede scènestreams. Vælg Animatic eller video for hver scene, saml en master, del links til gennemgang, og sorter tidsstemplet feedback før udgivelse.

steps.shortDescription: Distribuer din master til YouTube, eksporter korte klip, og følg publikumsindsigt fra én samlet platform til færdiggørelse.
steps.detailedDescription: Fra Screening Room kan du køre guiden til YouTube-publicering, oprette eksportfiler til korte videoer til sociale medier og downloade distributionspakker. Analyse og feedback fra korrekturlæsere samles ét sted – uden behov for overførsel til separate værktøjer.

cards.title: Filmlangt drama. Ingen karakterafvigelser.
cards.subtitle: Bevar karakterernes ansigter, kostumer og lokationer fra scene 1 til scene 100. Gå gennem visningsrummet for at se pre-vis, bevægelsesvideoer for hver scene og den endelige ProRes 4K-master – og skift derefter sprog for at høre den fulde dubbing.

solutionPillars.title: Visuel og karakter-konsistens
solutionPillars.friction: Generative modeller nulstilles ved hvert klip, hvilket får karakterernes ansigter, påklædning og lyssætning til løbende at ændre sig på tværs af klipskiftene.
solutionPillars.solution: Definér master-karakterprofiler, miljøer og visuelle stilarter på forhånd i Blueprint Room. SceneFlow håndhæver den visuelle identitet på tværs af alle renderinger for at bevare den narrative indlevelse.

solutionPillars.title: Fortællingens tempo og scenestyring
solutionPillars.friction: At skabe en film ud fra usammenhængende mikro-prompts resulterer i et hakkende tempo, manglende følelsesmæssig dybde og endeløs manuel redigering på tidslinjen.
solutionPillars.solution: Instruér på sceneniveau, ikke på promptniveau. Strukturér dramatiske højdepunkter, kamerabevægelser og handlingsforløb visuelt, før du genererer så meget som ét enkelt videobillede.

solutionPillars.title: Synkronisering af dialog og lyd
solutionPillars.friction: Manglende synkronisering mellem læber og lyd, svævende mundbevægelser og løsrevne lydspor river øjeblikkeligt seerne ud af dramaet.
solutionPillars.solution: Dynamisk stemmepræstation og præcis læbesynkronisering er integreret direkte i videopipelinen, hvilket sikrer troværdig dialog uden behov for ekstern efterbehandling.

solutionPillars.title: Friktion i arbejdsgangen og træthed ved gentagne forsøg
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: Kaos med aktiver og endeløse genrulninger.
solutionPillars.friction: At generere en kortfilm indebærer typisk, at man skal jonglere med over 200 rå videofiler, manuel opskalering og dusinvis af mislykkede genereringer.
solutionPillars.solution: Fra koncept til endelig master-MP4 på én samlet platform. Blueprint Room håndterer opsætningen af historien, Production Stage styrer instruktionen via streams, og Screening Room leverer det endelige eksportresultat.

cards.title: Animeret serie med flere stilarter over en hel sæson. Én gennemgående visuel stil.
cards.subtitle: Fastlæg én "flat-cel"-stil, familien Hart og byen Millwick fra første til sidste afsnit. Instruér hver enkelt pointe i humoren, og gennemgå derefter afsnittet i screeningsrummet.

solutionPillars.title: Stilistisk konsekvens
solutionPillars.friction: Tegnefilms- og animestyle forvrænges konstant mellem indstillingerne; stregerne skifter, farvepaletterne brydes sammen, og figurerne forvandles til en fotorealistisk, uhyggelig og uformelig masse.
solutionPillars.solution: Fastlås din visuelle stil fra første billede. SceneFlow låser karakterdesign, stregtykkelser og skyggemodeller gennem hele episoden, så dine karakterer forbliver unikt dine egne.

solutionPillars.title: Overdrevet animation og fysik
solutionPillars.friction: Generative modeller har svært ved hurtig slapstick, pludselige reaktioner og den bløde fysik, der kendetegner tegnefilm, hvilket forvandler energifyldte gags til smeltende visuelle fejl.
solutionPillars.solution: Skab dynamiske karakterbevægelser og udtryksfulde positurer uden at ødelægge geometrien. Styr slagkraftig fysisk komik, pludselige klip og vilde ansigtsudtryk med fuld kontrol over bevægelserne.

solutionPillars.title: Komisk timing og rytme
solutionPillars.friction: Humor opstår i pauserne og de præcise klip. Standardiserede generative loops på 5 sekunder tvinger en klodset rytme igennem, der ødelægger leveringen af vittigheden.
solutionPillars.solution: Styr scenens tempo helt ned på billedramme-niveau. Juster dramatiske pauser, timingen mellem oplæg og pointe samt hurtige reaktionsklip direkte på tidslinjen – med fokus på rytme og taktslag – før den endelige rendering.

solutionPillars.title: Energifyldt dialog og synkronisering af tale
solutionPillars.friction: Generisk AI-dialog virker flad og mekanisk og ødelægger den energi, der skal til for at skabe den hurtige, slagfærdige dialog, der kendetegner en sitcom.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Dynamisk synkronisering af stemme og udtryk.
solutionPillars.solution: Synkronisér stemmeføringen direkte med et energisk ansigtsspil. Dialog, udtryksfulde mundbevægelser og komiske lydspor smelter sømløst sammen og sikrer maksimal komisk effekt.

cards.title: Omfattende dokumentarfilm. Intelligensens fremmarch.
cards.subtitle: Følg fremkomsten af kunstig intelligens og superintelligens på tværs af kontinenter. Hvert kapitel afspejler sin egen tidsperiode – ingen moderne genstande i et tidligt laboratorium, ingen kulisser fra 1950'erne i nutiden.

solutionPillars.title: Tidsmæssig visuel autenticitet
solutionPillars.friction: Standardgenerative modeller lader rutinemæssigt moderne genstande, smartphoneskærme eller beklædning, der ikke passer til tidsperioden, snige sig ind i historiske rekonstruktioner.
solutionPillars.solution: Fastlæg præcise tidsmæssige parametre – lige fra filmkorn fra 1920'erne til teksturer i beklædning fra det 18. århundrede – så enhver genereret scene forbliver historisk autentisk.

solutionPillars.title: System til arkivklip og B-roll
solutionPillars.friction: At kombinere en længere fortællerstemme med statiske arkivbilleder fører til, at seerne hurtigt falder fra under dybdegående gennemgange.
solutionPillars.solution: Mens din fortæller gennemgår historiske fakta, genererer SceneFlow automatisk tidsstyrede, filmiske rekonstruktioner, dokument-overlays og arkiv-lignende indskudte klip, der er direkte knyttet til lydudskriften.

solutionPillars.title: Interview- og talking-head-realisme
solutionPillars.friction: Genererede historikere, efterforskere eller vidner virker ofte kunstige med svævende kæbebevægelser og unaturlig øjenkontakt.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Låste ekspertprofiler og synkronisering af stemme
solutionPillars.solution: Oprethold realistiske og troværdige interviewopsætninger med naturlige mikro-ansigtsudtryk, præcis læbesynkronisering og konsistente ekspertidentiteter på tværs af serier i flere dele.

solutionPillars.title: Episodisk tempo og narrativ kontinuitet
solutionPillars.friction: At afbalancere fortællerstemme, rekonstruktioner, afsløring af beviser og spændingsopbyggende pauser i et 40-minutters afsnit tager normalt ugevis i traditionelle NLE-systemer.
solutionPillars.solutionHeadline: Dokumentarproces med fokus på narrative beats
solutionPillars.solution: Opbyg dramatisk spænding, suspensefyldte pauser og afsløring af beviser visuelt i Blueprint Room, og lever en komplet samlet masterfil i én sammenhængende proces.

cards.title: Undervisningsklar træningsserie i flere moduler. Én indespærret kok.
cards.subtitle: Én kok, ét køkken, fem retter. Ansigtet, kokkejakken og fliserne forbliver uforandrede fra bouillonen til den sidste dessert.

solutionPillars.title: Konsistens i underviser og rammer
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: En ny underviser til hvert modul.
solutionPillars.friction: Generative klip nulstiller underviserens ansigt, påklædning og klasseværelse mellem lektionerne, så kurset føles som en samling af uafhængige videoer.
solutionPillars.solution: Definér instruktøren, settet og det visuelle system én gang i Blueprint Room. SceneFlow fastholder denne identitet på tværs af alle moduler.

solutionPillars.title: Tempo i undervisningsforløbet
solutionPillars.friction: Når en læseplan omdannes til løsrevne anvisninger, går undervisningens forløb, det gennemgåede eksempel og pausen før en quiz tabt.
solutionPillars.solution: Tilrettelæg hvert modul som en sekvens af undervisningstrin – introduktion, demonstration og kontrol – før en frame renderes.

solutionPillars.title: Fortællerstemme og undervisning på skærmen
solutionPillars.frictionHeadline: En stemme, der går glip af det grafiske.
solutionPillars.friction: Fortællestemme, undertekster og diagrammer kommer ud af takt, så de lærende hører ét trin, mens billedet viser et andet.
solutionPillars.solution: Stemme, undertekster og undervisning på skærmen følges ad, så hver forklaring falder sammen med det visuelle element, der underbygger den.

solutionPillars.title: Samling af kurset
solutionPillars.friction: At sammenføje moduler, genoptagelser og lokaliserede versioner på en traditionel tidslinje forvandler en opdatering af undervisningsmaterialet til en produktionsforsinkelse.
solutionPillars.solution: Blueprint, Audience Resonance og Screening Room fører et modul hele vejen fra skitse til Pre-Vis, grovklip, scener og det færdige kursus.

drama.logline: When a disgraced reporter breaches the subterranean bunker of an isolated infrastructure archivist to activate an 1893 atmospheric energy artifact, the pair must survive an elite strike team led by the corporate risk operative who murdered his wife—culminating in a choice between self-preservation and liberating humanity from artificial scarcity.
drama.seriesSynopsis: Set beneath a climate-battered American Midwest where private utility conglomerate Vane-Calhoun Energy weaponizes rolling winter blackouts to extract municipal concessions, The White City Current spans six 45-minute episodes. Former municipal archivist Gideon Croft and blacklisted investigative journalist Piper Hayes uncover a suppressed 1893 Columbian Exposition resonant-induction network engineered by Gideon’s late wife, Dr. Clara Vance-Croft. Across Season 1, lighting the Chicago Two-Mile Crib in Episode 1 triggers a high-stakes war across historic subterranean infrastructure corridors—from Detroit’s salt-mine substations to Niagara’s decommissioned wheel-pits—pitting public-grid liberation against Senior Risk Director Julian Ward’s private containment directorate.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Faraday Protocol
episode1Synopsis.duration: 42.5 min (8 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 6 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: A grieving tunnel archivist and a hunted reporter ignite an 1893 wireless power manifold beneath frozen Chicago and fight through two miles of sub-lakebed tunnels to broadcast the truth.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: During a lethal polar vortex engineered by Vane-Calhoun Energy to bankrupt Chicago’s South Side wards, Piper Hayes breaches Gideon Croft’s 1906 freight-tunnel bunker with the missing cryptographic key to his murdered wife Clara’s 1893 resonant induction manifold. Awakening the prototype alerts Julian Ward’s sanitization unit, forcing Gideon and a wounded Piper out of hiding and through steam sluices, an Adams Street pneumatic mail station, and a collapsing 1890s sub-lacustrine intake tunnel to couple the manifold to the offshore Two-Mile Crib.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Forty feet beneath freezing Chicago, Gideon Croft’s chalk-covered vault hums under stolen municipal current while radio dispatches count South Side blackout casualties. Piper Hayes bypasses his perimeter tripwires carrying Clara’s brass cipher and Vane-Calhoun’s load-shedding orders—forcing Gideon to confront the proof that Clara’s death was a corporate assassination.

episodes.title: Subterranean Isolation
episodes.synopsis: Establish Gideon’s defensive isolation in the 1906 Chicago freight tunnels, his obsession with rationalizing Clara’s murder as personal failure while Vane-Calhoun’s polar-vortex blackouts freeze the South Side, and Piper Hayes’s disruptive intrusion with Clara’s final cryptographic cipher.

episodes.title: Unlocking the Faraday Protocol
episodes.synopsis: Stage a fierce ideological collision as Piper confronts Gideon with internal Vane-Calhoun shutoff manifests and Clara’s handwritten plea—shattering his cynicism and forcing him to input the alignment sequence that wakes the resonant induction prototype in a violet electromagnetic surge.

episodes.title: The Claustrophobic Counter-Offensive
episodes.synopsis: Julian Ward’s tactical sanitization squad detonates breach charges into the vault. When Piper takes shrapnel shielding Gideon, he overcomes his instinct to seal himself away alone—guiding her through forgotten drainage sluices and scalding Ward’s contractors with an industrial steam bypass.

episodes.title: Suture and Sub-Station
episodes.synopsis: Taking shelter in a derelict pneumatic mail sorting station beneath Adams Street, Gideon field-sutures Piper’s wound in an intimate decompression beat that binds Clara’s legacy to Piper’s mission and cements Gideon’s commitment to the fight.

episodes.title: Breaching the Harbor Flue
episodes.synopsis: Cornered by Ward’s surface perimeter and timed thermite charges, Gideon and Piper execute an interdependent tactical breakthrough—jury-rigging a pressurized concussion canister in a pneumatic dispatch tube to blow open a ventilation flue to the frozen lakefront.

episodes.title: The Sub-Lacustrine Traverse
episodes.synopsis: Faced with two miles of churning pack ice to reach the offshore Two-Mile Crib, Gideon leads Piper through a hazardous, half-flooded 1890s brick water-intake siphon beneath the frozen lakebed—battling hypothermia, rising icy seepage, and structural collapse to haul her up the intake shaft.

episodes.title: Stand on the Gantry
episodes.synopsis: On the crib’s gale-swept gantry, Ward corners them with a high-voltage inversion relay and offers Gideon underground immunity and lab funding for Clara’s manifold. Gideon rejects corporate co-optation and hotwires Victorian hydraulic flood-gates to route Ward’s reverse charge back through the actuators.

episodes.title: The Harmonic Grid Transmission and Vindication
episodes.synopsis: Piper splices into the microwave uplink to broadcast Vane-Calhoun’s crimes to independent news outlets while Gideon couples Clara’s manifold to the regional array—unleashing a resonant harmonic transmission that restores heat and light across Chicago before Gideon burns his credentials at dawn.

animation.artStyle: 2D Flat-Cel Animation · Bold Ink Outlines & Warm Suburban Palette
animation.continuityLock: 5 Locked Family Character Sheets · Millwick House & Side Porch · Zero Style Drift
animation.artLock: One locked flat-cel style for the whole season: bold ink outlines, warm suburban color, and the same character designs in every episode. The platform can hold many styles. This series does not switch.
animation.logline: In Millwick, the Harts turn a household argument into the week’s joke, and the joke into the reason they still live under one roof.
animation.seriesSynopsis: Set in the civic-ordinance-obsessed town of Millwick, Hart House is a five-episode, 22-minute 2D animated family sitcom built to prove zero off-model drift across an entire broadcast season. Municipal clerk Ruth Hart and night-shift transit mechanic Ellis Hart share a cramped craftsman house with sixteen-year-old debate captain June, nine-year-old fact-collector Milo, and Ruth’s mother Nana Inez, whose “temporary” enclosed side porch has quietly become the emotional center of the home. Every episode turns a small municipal headache into rapid-fire ensemble comedy while keeping identical line weights, warm cel-shaded palettes, and multi-angle character sheets locked from Episode 1 through the Episode 5 household vote.

cast.name: Ruth Hart
cast.descriptor: Millwick Municipal Clerk (42). Terracotta knit cardigan, tortoiseshell glasses, color-coded wall calendar; deadpan vocal timing and expressive eyebrow arcs.

cast.name: Ellis Hart
cast.descriptor: Night-Shift Municipal Bus Mechanic (44). Navy shop coveralls, steel thermos, optimistic garage inventor who solves 5-minute chores with 40-pound contraptions.

cast.name: June Hart
cast.descriptor: High School Debate Captain (16). Mustard hoodie over pleated skirt, annotated town charter in hand; treats every dinner-table rule like a Supreme Court oral argument.

cast.name: Milo Hart
cast.descriptor: Household Archivist & Label-Maker Enthusiast (9). Striped rugby shirt, untied high-tops, industrial label gun; delivers devastatingly literal truths on the comedic beat.

cast.name: Nana Inez
cast.descriptor: Side-Porch Sovereign & Retired Seamstress (71). Embroidered indigo shawl, silver chignon, wicker throne; remembers every zoning variance on the block since 1984.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Sorting Rule
episode1Synopsis.duration: 22 min (4 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 5.5 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: A twelve-category town recycling mandate inspires Ellis to build a motorized garage sorting conveyor that accidentally classifies Nana Inez’s porch belongings as municipal surplus.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: When Millwick enacts Ordinance 412—requiring twelve color-coded curb bins by Thursday morning—Ruth wants quiet compliance so her coworkers at Town Hall cannot gossip, June drafts a constitutional challenge for the council mic, and Ellis constructs a pulley-driven sorting machine in the garage. The machine triumphs on glass bottles before devouring the family’s unlabeled storage boxes, culminating in a living-room standoff when Milo prints a tag reading “Nana’s Temporary Porch Things” and the family must admit nobody knows what “temporary” means.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1 (Cold Open & Act I): Twelve Bins by Thursday
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: At 6:15 a.m. in the locked Hart kitchen, Ruth unveils the town’s twelve-category sorting chart while Ellis returns from night shift with a salvaged bus-door motor. Across fast-cut flat-cel reaction shots, Milo begins labeling household furniture and Nana Inez declares the side porch exempt from municipal jurisdiction.

episodes.title: The Sorting Rule
episodes.synopsis: Millwick issues a new recycling order with twelve categories. Ellis builds a sorting machine in the garage. It works on bottles and then, disastrously, on the family’s unlabeled boxes. June wants to challenge the rule at the town meeting. Ruth wants the curb to look compliant by Thursday. The episode lands when Milo labels one box “Nana’s porch things” and nobody can agree what the label means.

episodes.title: Parade Weather
episodes.synopsis: Rain is forecast for Millwick Day. June wants to cancel her debate-club banner. Milo wants to log the lightning. Nana Inez refuses to wave at a neighbor she has avoided since a fence dispute. Ruth still has to host the block under a tarp. The joke is the tarp. The point is who gets to decide that a celebration happened.

episodes.title: Night Shift Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: Ellis gets home at dawn and cooks for people who are already leaving. June has a tournament. Milo has a field trip. Ruth has a counter shift. For one hour the kitchen is the whole family, and the eggs are the only conversation that fits. A burnt pancake becomes the running argument about whose morning the house is built around.

episodes.title: The Spare Key
episodes.synopsis: Someone has been refilling the cat’s bowl on the mornings Ellis oversleeps. The Harts investigate and find the key they hid under a brick years ago. The neighbor they have been calling nosy has been covering the dawn gap. Nana Inez has to decide whether to take the key back or admit the block has been helping.

episodes.title: The Porch Vote
episodes.synopsis: Nana Inez announces she is done with the “temporary” porch and will move to her sister’s town. The Harts call a household vote. Rebuilding the porch as her real rooms means Ellis’s garage project stops, June’s study corner moves, and Millwick has to permit a change it has been ignoring. The season turns here: the comedy is no longer about a messy week. It is about who gets to stay.

documentary.artStyle: Era-Accurate Archival Realism (1950s 16mm Grain → 1980s CRT → Modern 4K)
documentary.continuityLock: 2 Recurring Witnesses (Dr. Amira Hassan & Kenji Sato) · 12 Global Cities · Strict Period Guardrails
documentary.artLock: Period accuracy is the rule of the picture. A 1956 lab has period wardrobe, film grain, and the machines of that year — no flat screens, no phones. A present-day chapter looks like now. The same two witnesses, Dr. Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato, keep the same faces across every era they appear in.
documentary.logline: A five-part documentary follows intelligence — built, borrowed, and still unfinished — from the first useful machines to the question of a system smarter than its makers.
documentary.seriesSynopsis: Spanning seventy years and twelve cities across five continents, The Long Thought is a five-part, 200-minute documentary series tracing humanity’s attempt to externalize reasoning—from 1956 relay rooms in Manchester and Tokyo to contemporary foundation-model infrastructure and the governance horizon of superintelligence. Anchored by recurring on-camera witnesses Dr. Amira Hassan (Cairo/London) and Kenji Sato (Osaka/Tokyo), SceneFlow’s Historical Style Guardrails lock period-authentic lenses, wardrobe, and room geometry per decade while automatically weaving transcript-synced archival cutaways, schematics, and multi-language narration.

cast.name: Dr. Amira Hassan
cast.descriptor: Mathematical Logician & AI Governance Scholar. Appears in 1980s Cairo/Paris archival recreations (age 28) and present-day 4K London interview plates (age 64) with locked facial structure and vocal cadence.

cast.name: Kenji Sato
cast.descriptor: Industrial Control & Semiconductor Engineer. Tracked from 1980s Osaka/Seoul fabrication floors to contemporary Tokyo robotics archives with natural micro-expressions and lip-sync.

cast.name: The Chronicler (Narrator)
cast.descriptor: Measured, unsensationalist documentary narrator driving transcript-timed archival B-roll and localized audio mixes in English, Spanish, Chinese, and Arabic.

cast.name: Historical Lab & Field Ensemble
cast.descriptor: 1956 Manchester and Tokyo computing pioneers, 1989 Nairobi hospital records analysts, and present-day practitioners in Manila, Accra, and Rotterdam—strictly filtered against modern anachronisms.

episode1Synopsis.title: Episode 1: The Room with the Switches (1950–1968)
episode1Synopsis.duration: 40 min (5 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 6 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: In post-war Manchester, Princeton, and Tokyo, a handful of mathematicians and relay engineers wire rooms the size of gymnasiums to test whether a machine can hold a rule and change its mind.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: Episode 1 reconstructs the physical and philosophical birth of machine intelligence between 1950 and 1968. Moving between 16mm archival-grade recreations of Manchester’s Ferranti Mark 1, Tokyo’s ETL Mark III relay room, and Dartmouth’s 1956 summer study, Dr. Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato examine the artifacts their mentors left behind—showing how early researchers mistook formal logic for human common sense, yet laid the switching architecture that still governs modern compute.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1: The Relay That Remembered (Manchester & Tokyo, 1956)
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Shot in locked 1956 16mm grain with zero modern artifacts, engineers in wool waistcoats trace a fault across clattering electromagnetic relays in Manchester and Tokyo, intercut with crisp 4K present-day interview plates of Amira Hassan and Kenji Sato holding original 5-hole punched tape—closing on a single toggle switch left on through the night.

episodes.title: The Room with the Switches
episodes.synopsis: Mid-century labs in Manchester, Princeton, and Tokyo. Researchers in period dress stand over machines that do one clever thing in a loud room. Amira’s teacher, on a later interview tape, describes the hope without using a single object from the future. Kenji’s uncle services a factory controller the size of a wardrobe. The chapter ends on a switch left in the on position overnight.

episodes.title: The Useful Machine
episodes.synopsis: The 1980s and 1990s. An expert system in a Nairobi hospital records room, a chip floor in Seoul, a translation office in Paris. Beige terminals, CRT glow, clothing and cars of that decade. Amira, young, watches a program suggest a diagnosis a senior clinician rejects. Kenji sees a line stop because a sensor trusted itself. Useful, and already arguing with the people beside it.

episodes.title: The Public Arrival
episodes.synopsis: The 2010s. A Lagos newsroom, a São Paulo classroom, a Berlin kitchen where a phone answers a question a child asked out loud. The model has left the lab. Amira is now the person reporters call. Kenji’s factory posts a notice that the night shift will “consult the system.” The chapter holds on faces reading a screen, not on the screen.

episodes.title: The Acceleration
episodes.synopsis: One present day, three cities. A nurse in Manila, a composer in Accra, a dock planner in Rotterdam. Each uses a system that finishes a sentence they started. The narrator counts what sped up and who was not in the room when the terms were set. Amira and Kenji, older, compare the notices on their doors. The pictures are contemporary: current dress, current streets, current light.

episodes.title: The Question Ahead
episodes.synopsis: The superintelligence horizon, told as a question rather than a prophecy. Amira and Kenji sit in a quiet archive — papers, photographs, and a machine that is not pretending to be a person. They ask what a system smarter than its makers would owe the nurse, the composer, the dock planner, and the people who never touched the switch. The series does not answer. It leaves the obligation in the room.

episode1Synopsis.title: Module 1: The Broth — Extraction, Clarity & Heat Control
episode1Synopsis.duration: 15 min (3 Chapters · Chapter 1 Live Proof: 5 min)
episode1Synopsis.logline: Chef Lila Mensah teaches heat management, aromatics, and skimming discipline through a crystal-clear foundation broth that powers the rest of the curriculum.
episode1Synopsis.synopsis: In Module 1, Chef Lila Mensah establishes the Harbor Street workbench and teaches the foundational skill of the course: transforming cold water, roasted bones or root vegetables, and aromatics into a clear, structured broth. Structured into three instructional chapters—(1) Cold Start & Knife Mise en Place, (2) The Convection Simmer & Skim, and (3) Late-Stage Salt Calibration & Clarity Check—learners master thermal control before touching flour or roast proteins in later modules.
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Title: Chapter 1: Cold Water, Clean Bones & The First Simmer
episode1Synopsis.chapter1Synopsis: Opening on A-Cam in the daylight-balanced Harbor Street Kitchen, Chef Lila Mensah introduces the five-plate syllabus, switches to a locked 90° overhead B-Cam to demonstrate uniform mirepoix cuts and cold-water submersion, and brings the stockpot to its first lazy convection bubble alongside apprentices Marcus and Priya.

episodes.title: The Broth
episodes.synopsis: Lila starts with a clear broth: knife, bones or vegetables, heat, and patience. She shows the simmer, the skim, and the moment salt goes in. The kitchen, the coat, and her face are established as the locked set. The check is a spoonful that tastes finished, not cloudy.

episodes.title: The Bread
episodes.synopsis: Same bench, same chef. Dough, time, and the feel of a proved loaf. Lila ties the broth’s lesson about patience to the wait the dough requires. Students shape, score, and bake. The check is a crumb that is open, not gummy, and a note on what they would change next time.

episodes.title: The Vegetable Main
episodes.synopsis: A pan of greens and grains that has to feed the whole class, not a camera. Lila shows a sauce built from the broth, seasoning for a group, and how to hold color in the vegetables. The check is a plate that is the same in the first bowl and the last.

episodes.title: The Celebration Roast
episodes.synopsis: A center plate for a night that matters: roast, rest, and a side that uses yesterday’s bread. Lila keeps the same station and the same voice while the stakes of the plate go up. The check is carving for a table, not a single hero shot.

episodes.title: The Last Sweet
episodes.synopsis: A dessert that needs the heat control of module 1, the timing of module 2, and the seasoning eye of module 3. Then the class sets all five plates as one meal. Lila walks the pass in the same coat, in the same kitchen. The course turns from lessons into a service.

audienceResonance.title: Audience Resonance: byg til en kultur, ikke en sprogkode
audienceResonance.description: Undertekster udvider en videos rækkevidde. Med SceneFlow kan du definere den kultur, region og målgruppe, du producerer til, vurdere historien i forhold til denne målgruppe, før du renderer, og derefter levere enten en master med dubbing eller en separat version, der er skræddersyet til at skabe størst mulig genklang hos den enkelte målgruppe.
bullets: Definér målgruppen: otte målregioner samt alder, køn, uddannelse og lokalsamfund.
Beskriv kultur, tro og værdier med dine egne ord – SceneFlow aflæser signalerne.
Få en resonansscore med forslag til justeringer på sektionsniveau, før du bruger penge på renderinger.
Lav dubs af masteren, eller producer en særskilt version tilpasset hvert enkelt publikum.

howWeScore.title: Sådan fungerer Audience Resonance
howWeScore.description: Audience Resonance kombinerer analyse af den narrative struktur (klarhed, tempo, følelsesmæssig bue) med, hvor godt indholdet matcher den målgruppe-persona, du har defineret i Blueprint – frem for blot overfladiske nøgletal eller fastholdelsesdata indsamlet efter udgivelse. Hvis din målgruppebeskrivelse indeholder kulturelle markører, foretager analysen desuden en vurdering af autenticiteten i forhold til navne, dialekt, skikke, tro og kulturelle følsomheder. Anbefalingerne er knyttet til specifikke dele af manuskriptet, så du kan udbedre eventuelle problemer, før agenterne igangsætter videogenereringen.
bullets: Vurderer Blueprint og manuskriptet i forhold til din angivne målgruppe.
Kontrol af kulturel autenticitet i forhold til navne, dialekt, skikke, tro og følsomme emner
Anbefalinger på sektionsniveau – ikke et "black box"-tal, hvor man bare skal stole på os
Kør det, før der bruges mange ressourcer på rendering, ikke efter publicering.
